Girl I don't know what to say about your loss, it's very painful  seeing your loved ones going far from us maybe we can never see them again, but the time we shared with each other will be always be in our memories and that's the only thing that is gonna remain with us forever. 
I will not say that I feel sympathy for you Or feel sad for you because it won't help to heal your pain, your wounds, especially you. 
Practically you have three ways left, first is to conveince your and your boyfriend's family for marriage, make them realise how much you love them, it's too hard and seems to be impossible sometimes but think of it, if you somehow managed to make this far you will be with the love of your life. 
Second, it's harder than the first one and looks a bit wrong socially and morally, but think of it if a family can't see their children's happiness then they don't deserve to be respected and you don't need to worry about them, but in that case both you and your bf must be agree with it and not just one person left one's family and when it came to marriage other person left first person alone and imagine if this happens with you, what else would be left for you? You won't have any family Or love anymore, no one will be with you that time. I don't want to scare you, just telling the truth what possibilities do you have. 
Third is to let him go, yeah it is most painful way to live, but it is what it is😢 , not just you whoever is in this condition can't do anything in it and have to accept the truth. You can still live with his memories. Live a better life, and somehow try not to remember him (if you can't apply previous options), it's is the hardest thing to do ( try to move on, if you ever can)  i know, i know it will never be easy, and how could it be easy to forget someone, it's like removing your heart from your body while being  conscious.

Remember one thing, if he really loves you he would make efforts, but making efforts is not like he would leave his family for a girl. You have to understand that situation is against for both of you. He can't leave his family( and you also can't leave yours) and you can't leave him. 

I can completely understand your feelings I am just a different passenger of the same boat as yours. 

I am not a speaker or therapist so I can't make you feel better, it was all I could do for you. 


         ~ A stranger passenger from the same boat.
